clips.title: The story
paras: In Ironforge, Prospector Stormpike oversees support for distant archaeological digs. A blunt, short-tempered dwarf of the renowned Stormpike clan, he also uses his sharp mind to decipher coded messages.

Prospector Stormpike coordinates excavations from the Library of the Hall of Explorers. His work sends supplies, including blasting powder, to distant sites across Khaz Modan and beyond. He is impatient with idle chatter, but his dedication to uncovering dwarven history runs deep. His keen mind can break intricate ciphers, making him a useful ally to scouts facing secret threats.
